title: echium italicum subsp. biebersteinii
intro: Echium italicum subsp. biebersteinii, commonly known as Italian bugloss or giant bugloss, is a subspecies of the Echium italicum plant, a flowering plant in the borage family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Italian bugloss include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory activity. The bioactive constituents of Echium italicum subsp. biebersteinii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
